scope: Vietnamese equities swing research; numerical observations and calculations only

rules.missing: Null with reason, never an artificial zero or neutral observation
rules.zero: Valid only when the source explicitly observed zero; distinguish not reported, not subscribed and not applicable
rules.time: Use only records with available_at <= decision time; event date and period end do not establish availability
rules.revisions: Preserve original vintages and corrections; latest snapshots cannot be joined backward as historical observations
rules.derived: Store formula and upstream hashes; derived candles are not independent external information
rules.rights: Separate feature-adjusted prices from executable raw prices and actual cash/share entitlements
rules.source_verification: Documentation verified is not payload, historical coverage or usage-right verification
rules.numeric_documents: Tabulated numerical disclosures may be parsed with source evidence; narrative text is not a model feature

price_basis_audit.calculation_view_method: raw_factor=close_unadj/close_adj; open/high/low are adjusted fields multiplied by that same-row ratio; close=close_unadj
publication_vintage_fields: created_at only; ingestion time is not source availability
price_basis_audit.stored_adj_factor_semantics: UNRESOLVED; direct and reciprocal conventions both fail at tolerance in this audit
price_basis_audit.decision: Descriptive price integrity checks only; do not use as verified executable raw/PIT history for profitability research

source_lineage_audit.current_DNSE_writer: Maps GET /price/ohlc t/o/h/l/c/v into adjusted fields and seeds close_unadj from the same close; public docs reviewed do not settle raw/adjusted semantics or historical revisions/availability.
source_lineage_audit.upsert_vintage_risk: Overwrites adjusted OHLC and data_source but retains a prior non-null close_unadj; source/vintage mixing is possible, not confirmed on individual rows.
source_lineage_audit.documented_working_date_limit: DNSE endpoint describes a rolling one-year window; does not provide a full historical calendar
source_lineage_audit.next_evidence: A hashed paired provider payload and LOCAL row with retrieval/source vintage, plus service retention and research-use entitlement; recover original loaders for legacy labels.
